newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Xilinx raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Xilinx raised to buy.

text.p: -- UBS Securities confirmed analyst Charles Boucher upgraded Xilinx Inc to buy from hold.
-- Said Xilinx's fourth quarter earnings were in line with expectations and cited improving outlook for upgrade.
-- In separate actions, Morgan Stanley said it started coverage of Xilinx with an outperform rating.

Also, Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette and Dean Witter both raised Xilinx to buy, a market source said. DLJ had rated Xilinx market perform and Dean Witter had rated the company accumulate, the source said.
